At some point following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] led by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] '''infiltrated''' the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] and stole [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|helmet]].

==The operation==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] Han Solo and his strike team infiltrated [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']]. They got onboard the vessel presumably by the help of a nervous officer, who feared Vader's heavy-handed managerial style. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] team successfully arrived to the [[Darth Vader's meditation chamber/Legends|Dark Lord's meditational chamber]] and stole his [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|helmet]]. The theft caused the blast door of this section of the ''Executor'' to close, trapping the invaders.<ref name="Theft 1">See Scenario Background section of {{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/vadershelmet|text=The Theft of Vader's Helmet|int=The Theft of Vader's Helmet}}</ref> [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Piett]] and some [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were inside the sealed zone and they helped Vader to fight the intruders.<ref name="Theft 2">Piett and the troops should be inside the sealed zone, otherwise they couldn't participate the fight. See Imperial Setup section of {{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/vadershelmet|text=The Theft of Vader's Helmet|int=The Theft of Vader's Helmet}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SWMdeathstarmap.jpg|thumb|left|A possible place of the mission aboard the ''Executor'']]
The mission appeared only in [[The Theft of Vader's Helmet]] scenario for the [[Star Wars Miniatures]] RPG-based tabletop game. The scenario suggested the Tractor Beam Reactor Coupling map to play on, which may or may not represent the actual place of the ambush. The scenario suggested [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]] or [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] for the Rebel strike team, but their participation in a mission led by Solo is highly unlikely, and should not be considered canon, since the Rebel team is assorted by the player.
